elevatorCode.description: Human-readable display code, e.g. W-02, S-01. Display-only -- never the primary key (revised plan section A.2).

siteCode.description: e.g. whz, test. Matches core.site_id / MQTT topic siteId segment.

streamSeq.description: Decimal string, never a JSON number. Range 1..9223372036854775807 (signed bigint max). Encoded as a string specifically because a JSON number loses precision above 2^53 in JavaScript consumers, and this counter is expected to run for months without resetting (revised plan section A.2, test C04). Compare numerically (BigInt in Node, int in Python), never lexically.

floorRaw.description: The opaque wire-level position code as a decimal string, 0-63 (6-bit encoder). Never arithmetic on this value in a consumer -- it is a label lookup key, not a floor number (CLAUDE.md section 3.3-3.4; revised plan section A.7).

maskHex.description: The raw 13-hex-nibble (52-bit) mask exactly as received on the wire, kept for audit/replay, never decoded further by a schema consumer.

firmwareVersion.description: Nullable: a board running firmware older than 1.2.0 never announces LIFT= or a version at all.
